title: Multiple servers
prompt: Combine two MCP servers so the agent can retrieve information from one and prepare an action in another.

examples.code:
mcp_servers:
  - type: url
    name: github
    url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
  - type: url
    name: linear
    url: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly
tools:
  - type: mcp_toolset
    mcp_server_name: github
  - type: mcp_toolset
    mcp_server_name: linear
examples.label: YAML reference excerpt

actions.label: Prepare an action from retrieved data

takeaway: Combine two MCP servers so the agent can retrieve information from one and prepare an action in another.
